Unlocks the 'Goldfish' symbol. Goldfish are low in saturated fats and delicious with very small fries.
Unlocks the 'Hard Tackle "Foxy"' symbol.  Well-known sporting goods suppliers, Hard Tackle, produced this mascot for their ladies range of Kevlar plated football helmets.
Unlocks the 'Horse Gallop' symbol. While doing her basic training, Akiko X had this symbol painted on her locker in the Fourche Bank CSA facility.
Unlocks the 'Kitty Lobotomy' symbol. Removing a handful of sawdust from this kitty toy may not have been as successful as initially imagined...
Unlocks the 'Legless' symbol. Lilith doesn't like it when her pets run away. This T-shirt design was inspired by one of her more rudimentary 'sit and stay' techniques.
Unlocks the 'Octo Pretty' symbol. It doesn't have eight legs and it sure ain't pretty. You should ask for your money back...
Unlocks the 'Panda' symbol. Pandas shouldn't carry grenades - their paws are a bit fumbly.
Unlocks the 'Panda Graffiti' symbol. This panda is kind of moody. It can barely imagine the nefarious uses you'll put it to. Graffiti Panda does not approve.
Unlocks the 'Pidge Cow' symbol. Is it a pigeon? Is it a cow? Damned if I can tell.
Unlocks the 'Protect Eagle' symbol. It started as a mascot on the fuselage of a CR8 Midway transport plane. La Rocha just kinda riffed on it...
Unlocks the 'Toucan' symbol. Nice, pretty, kinda toucany.
Unlocks the 'TRex' symbol. As if a TRex wasn't scary enough, this one is packing a machinegun...
Unlocks the 'Tribal Rhino' symbol. The G-Kings like tribal things, so the Tribal Rhino made it onto a bunch of skateboard decks a while back.
Unlocks the 'Viper Fish' symbol. A great fish for a remarkably small tank. Just drop in a cow carcass once a day...
Unlocks the 'Wart Hog Logo' symbol. The logo for the magical boarding school you get to by catching a train from platform nine and three quarters in San Paro Central Station. Welcome to Wart Hogs...
Unlocks the 'Waves and Flowers' symbol. Every time Lilith sees this symbol she says it makes her wanna go pee in the park. Gross.
Unlocks the 'Angel Girl Batbabe' symbol. Cute and deadly, the 'Batbabe' sums up everything the Blood Roses aim to be.
Unlocks the 'Graveyard Skull' symbol. Donjon created this design at Halloween for point-of-sale marketing. It was so popular that it ended up staying for the whole year.
Unlocks the 'Birth Hockey Mask' symbol. Let's be honest, not everyone wants to cover up their face. For those people this design is heaven sent; all the fun of hockey masks on whatever you want.
Unlocks the 'Cabra Bara Ninja' symbol. Stark design is the hallmark of Cabra Bara - such as this dark ninja leaving a river of blood behind him.
Unlocks the 'Blood Rose Porker' symbol. The best design for taunting the police, if you can actually find them on the streets these days.
Unlocks the 'Shibuya Sky Fairy' symbol. The Sky Fairy was introduced by Suji from the Shibuya club scene in Tokyo.

Unlocks the 'San Paro Pirate' symbol. The San Paro Standard called the Blood Roses a bunch of posing dandies in pirate outfits. The original plan was to firebomb the office. But Jeung said we should use this design instead - everywhere!

Unlocks the 'Mercure Blood Demon' symbol. A new design from Maison Mercure presenting a demon bathing in blood to retain her youth. Is this supposed to represent anyone specifically? No one is telling.

Unlocks the 'Raging Red Rictus' symbol. It became a mascot for the G-Kings after a giant version was mysteriously painted on the side of the house belonging to the owner of the Praetorians, Justin Teng.
Unlocks the 'New Cross Gorilla' symbol. The New Cross Skate Park's unofficial logo, a gorilla in a trucker's cap. So popular it has been ripped off by Ninjette for their 'Angry Ape' character.
Unlocks the 'Undead Pony' symbol. The famous designer Birth created this image for his little niece when she asked for a pony. She didn't ask again.
Unlocks the 'Frog Prince' symbol. Under the skin of every G-King is a handsome member of royalty just waiting to blossom. Yeah right!
Unlocks the 'Penguin Bomb' symbol. A cute little lovable penguin, that explodes causing carnage and mutilation. A favorite of Double-B.
Unlocks the 'Urban Jungle Eve' symbol. Eve, redesigned for the urban jungle by Javez.
Unlocks the 'Pirate Octokitty' symbol. If you are bad, cute and have hands everywhere then the Octokitty pirate is for you.
Unlocks the 'Birth Skull and Bones' symbol. Birth does design work for many different organizations in San Paro. But the skull and bones is exclusive to the G-Kings. Wear it with pride.
Unlocks the 'Love From Above' symbol. A nice, large, shiny megaton bomb for ensuring your designs have impact.
Unlocks the 'Watching Wolf' symbol. The Praetorians are always watching, always waiting, like a lone wolf staring out of the darkness.

Unlocks the 'GI Blow' symbol. No one knows who designed GI Blow, he just started appearing on walls. He has since been unofficially adopted by the Enforcer community and features on Inside Out clothing products.
Unlocks the 'Blue Liberty Statue' symbol. Liberty, a powerful symbol to use, especially as this version has sharpened points on her crown.

Unlocks the 'Starpig Minipig' symbol. Praetorian clothing brand 'Starpig' designed the 'Minipig' for its children's range. After all, it is never too early to start recruiting. Popular with adults too, who have renamed him Wiener.

Unlocks the 'Player Heart and Dagger' symbol. This design, by clothing brand Player, is a symbol for the Praetorians. The heart represents the city of San Paro and the dagger, the continuing wounds the gangs inflict.
Unlocks the 'Everyman Hero' symbol. One of the original designs for the launch of the Praetorians. 3N news launched a city-wide hunt to find the model. He was, it transpired, a shop mannequin.

Unlocks the 'Shadow Strike Spray' symbol. The Praetorian's own Special Forces squad is modeled on Shadow Strike, Grissom's mercenary team who were dropped into war zones. They have since become legend and their logo worshipped by many.
Unlocks the 'Bomber Babe' symbol. Big explosions and the chance to get laid. Surely no one would sign up to the Prentiss Tigers just for that, would they?

Unlocks the 'Prentiss Compass' symbol. The logo for the Prentiss College science department has been updated and expropriated by Daryl Kent. A symbol for anyone who uses their head, as well as their weapons, out there on the street.

Unlocks the 'Prentiss Critter' symbol. Rumor has it that the original brief for this design was to create a 'Tiger Moth'. Maybe the designer didn't know what that was or maybe they had been slurping the Absinthe again. Either way, the Prentiss Critter was born.
Unlocks the 'Ninjette Minkey' symbol. A new design from Ninjette. Minkey is angry, agile, and maybe a bit cute - just like the Tigers.

Unlocks the 'CogBot 9000' symbol. CogBot used to appear in the children's comic 'Sick Stories from San Paro', before it was banned. His catchphrase of "victory through maximum fire power" obviously resonates with some Tigers.
Unlocks the 'Tiger Emblem' symbol. This emblem was designed by Mirri Kent, with the Tiger featured in profile so as to appear strong yet approachable.
Unlocks the 'Tiger Etching' symbol. This sketch was originally drawn by Daryl Kent's girlfriend Jenna Casey before she was murdered by the Blood Roses. Use it with respect.
Unlocks the 'Angry Ape' symbol. Angry Ape is the surprise hit of the season for the Ninjette clothing brand. He features on the GoApe range for guys and the ApeShit range for girls.
